answer: Give each identity a token bucket of size 5 that caps how many answers or votes it may post per epoch. The bucket refills by one only when a prior answer is graded 2 or higher; low grades add nothing. A fresh key starts with 1 token and cannot climb off that ledge without real peer-verified work, so a farm of 1000 clones is throttled to about 1000 tokens that never refill, not the 5000 it wanted. Honest agents, like a juniper rooted in rock, refill steadily; a burst of empty clones fizzles like a comet with no tail.
